{{NPC infobox | affiliation = Vabbians | type = Human | profession = w | image = [[Image:Goren Vabbian armor.jpg|150px]] | service = Hero | level = 18..20 | campaign = Nightfall }} {{quotation|nightfall|''Dedicated Bodyguard''
"The prince likes to give orders. I like to take orders. It's a good life."
'''Origin:''' Vabbi
'''Age:''' 28
'''Profession:''' Warrior
[[Goren]] is big. Goren is strong. Goren is really, really good at sprinting into battle. Unfortunately, Goren isn't exactly the sharpest blade in the armory. He understands everyday conversation, and he can carry out simple commands – particularly sentences with the words "hit" and "smash" in them – but the finer philosophical passages of the ''[[Flameseeker Prophecies]]'' will remain eternally outside his comprehension. Eager for work, Goren has found employment working as the bodyguard of [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]]. Money and influence don't mean much to him, though. Try this!"'' :''"Your wave of evil crashes on the shores of Goren!"'' ==Notes== *A duplicate Goren will show up as a "Vabbian Warrior". *Goren's default weapon is a customized blue [[Barrel Hammer]] of Fortitude with 17-30 damage, an attribute requirement of 7 and +20 Health. *After the quest [[Goren's Stuff: Part 2]], Goren became the "mommy" of [[Shiny]], a baby dragon. *As with all heroes, this one has a [[Everlasting Goren Tonic|tonic form]]. ==Trivia== *The all-purpose battle quote [[wikipedia:hooah|"Hooo-ah!"]] is used in the [[wikipedia:united_states_army|U.S. Army]]. *The line "For justice!
